Current stack:
- PWA (index.html — 6900 lines, single file)
- Kotlin CNS layer (OllamaBridge, PersistentDamn1Layer, EvidenceExporter, BridgeRepair)
- Python sensor bridge (sensors_ws.py on 8765)
- SAGE server (server.py on 8001)
- Ollama on 11434 with cloud models (Kimi K2, Gemini Flash, Nemotron)
- GitHub Actions for APK build (planned)
